note: Narrow is a declared projection of Wide (#1634) and both carry column windows (#1645): the parent serves a shared non-key cell only where its own window covers the instant. Wide's Field serves 2015..2016, so Narrow's FieldA (the same window) is dropped and Narrow's FieldB serves 2017..2019 in Narrow's own file. A file is the table's edition (#1661), so Narrow's one file carries its shared key Id over the source's 2015..2019 beside FieldB's 2017..2019, and Wide's file carries Id and Field. Fails if the parent wins by its table's edition instead of its window (FieldB dropped, Narrow emits nothing and a 2017..2019 coverage gap blocks the order), if a projection's window is ignored (FieldA no longer lies inside Wide's window and is emitted beside Wide's Field), or if files are grouped by the clipped requested period instead of the table's edition (Narrow's Id 2015..2019 falls in another unit than FieldB's 2017..2019 and is dropped, leaving Narrow's file without its key).
